original_test_intent: Execute the approved AMD Linux Board Production Suite external-manufacturing board test with its complete intended item set and verify every item plus PCIe/OS error health.
original_method: Pin and validate BPS against the board/GPU/driver/firmware matrix, enumerate and safety-review every configured item, capture stable GPU/BDF and error baselines, run exact `./tserver -boardtest=extmfg` once under watchdog and independent thermal/power monitoring, retain per-item status, compare CE/UCE/fatal/non-fatal and log deltas, restore documented temporary state and verify recovery.
manual_activity: Board/GPU production-test owner supplies and approves the exact BPS suite/config, every item action/oracle and abort/recovery policy and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: Signed pinned BPS installer/binaries and extmfg documentation
Complete reviewed config and item/action/oracle roster
Stable GPU/PCIe BDF map and accepted dmesg/lspci/AER baseline rules
Maintenance window, approval, watchdog, telemetry, cleanup and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Reject unknown, undocumented or unapproved configured items
Identify writes/resets/stress actions before enabling them
Continuously monitor thermal, power, driver and PCIe health
Abort on tool/item timeout, reset, CE/UCE/fatal/non-fatal delta or unsafe telemetry
Preserve logs and restore only documented temporary state; never auto-retry the aggregate suite
agent_execution_scope: Validate immutable suite/config/support/item roster and baselines
After approval run exact extmfg suite once under watchdog
Collect every item and error/telemetry delta plus cleanup evidence
Escalate anomalies without assigning DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve complete item scope, actions, oracles and support matrix
Approve maintenance/abort/recovery and interpret error deltas
Disposition incomplete/failing items and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic instruction cannot prove which BPS items ran or preserve the source's exact extmfg invocation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable config review and approval, run local exact `./tserver -boardtest=extmfg` once with watchdog; do not enable any item absent from the signed roster.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `extmfg` board-test selector, ten-minute attendance and thirty-minute machine window remain; item-specific timeouts must fit the approved plan.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash suite and config, emit the expanded ordered item roster before execution, correlate per-item timings/results with telemetry and before/after PCIe/log snapshots, then verify cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'all items' deterministic and reveals potentially destructive production steps while preserving aggregate BPS coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A subset smoke run or clean generic grep cannot substitute for every approved item and full BDF/AER evaluation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BPS may report top-level PASS despite skipped or internally retried items, so the per-item roster/status and timestamps are authoritative evidence.

project_override_considerations: Manufacturing owner controls the exact external-manufacturing profile; project-specific exclusions must be explicit and cannot silently redefine 'all'.
expected_evidence: BPS installer/binary/version hashes and support-matrix approval
Config hash plus expanded ordered item/action/parameter/oracle roster
Stable board/GPU/BDF inventory and pre-run dmesg/lspci/AER/SEL baseline
Exact argv, complete top-level and per-item stdout/stderr/status/timestamps
Thermal/power/watchdog trace and CE/UCE/fatal/non-fatal before/after matrix

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines BPS extmfg aggregate execution and all-item plus error-health acceptance; it is broad but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The proprietary suite, config and policy are provisionable project inputs; their current absence does not invalidate the completed static review.

review_improvement: Turns an unbounded 'all items' request into a frozen reviewed execution manifest with per-item attribution and complete error-delta evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A production suite is an orchestrator, not one test: its behavior is defined by the exact configuration and can include resets, stress or writes. Top-level PASS can hide skipped items, while post-run dmesg grep can miss BDF-specific AER status. Therefore the expanded roster, per-item result, independent telemetry and before/after BDF error matrix must all agree before an engineer can decide the DUT result.
